Initially, the One of the staff outright denied that any free trial even exist now and instead pushed for a paid day pass for 400Rs. A free trial is meant to attract potential members and create a welcoming first impression — not make people feel embarrassed, judged, or publicly questioned. The receptionist’s tone and handling of the situation were extremely unprofessional and lacked even basic courtesy or customer respect.
